text:
Sampled-candidate HR@10 cannot be assumed to measure full-catalog ranking quality. Foundational work shows sampling can reverse model comparisons even in expectation; a RecSys 2025 study further examines sampling reliability under biased logged feedback. Thus, retain the pinned 99-negative macro validation HR@10 for selection and treat full-catalog results as separate diagnostics. Neither protocol establishes real user satisfaction from incomplete interaction labels. Sources: [On Sampled Metrics](https://www.ijcai.org/proceedings/2021/0651.pdf), [Sampling Reliability, 2025](https://doi.org/10.1145/3705328.3748086).

For uncertainty, a suitable adaptation is paired user bootstrap: retain each model’s hit indicator on identical users and candidates, resample users within each category using identical indices across models, then average the four category differences equally. Report the observed difference and a 95% interval. This estimates uncertainty over validation users conditional on the fixed training run and candidates; it excludes training-seed variability and does not correct repeated-search selection bias. Pair-preserving resampling is supported by [SciPy’s bootstrap documentation](https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/generated/scipy.stats.bootstrap.html); [2024 distributional evaluation research](https://841.io/doc/disteval.pdf) motivates examining effectiveness beyond averages.

Recommended diagnostic design, rather than an established finding for these datasets: define popularity and history-length strata from training interactions only; report subgroup counts, hits, differences and intervals. With 200 validation users/category, fine strata will be unstable. On the same validation users, compare sampled versus full-catalog target ranks, hit agreement and model ordering. Check whether diagnostic changes consistently accompany HR@10 improvements separately in all four datasets. Twenty simulator users support qualitative inspection, not reliable subgroup conclusions. No retrieved evidence establishes that these probes predict failures across this exact four-dataset benchmark.
